name: tdsp
description: TDSP, the Together Document Sync Protocol: a specification and reference implementation for end-to-end encrypted collaborative documents carried over existing messengers.
author: wappensc (https://github.com/wappensc)

scripts.verify:network: pnpm run netcheck && pnpm run depcruise && pnpm exec vitest run tools/
scripts.pretest:l2: pnpm run matrix:reset && pnpm run matrix:up
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run depcruise && pnpm run netcheck && pnpm run licenses:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.matrix:up: node --experimental-strip-types infra/matrix-testserver/generate-config.ts && docker compose -f infra/matrix-testserver/docker-compose.yml up -d && node --experimental-strip-types infra/matrix-testserver/wait-for-health.ts && node --experimental-strip-types infra/matrix-testserver/provision-test-accounts.ts
scripts.email:up: docker compose -f infra/email-testserver/docker-compose.yml up -d && node --experimental-strip-types infra/email-testserver/wait-for-health.ts
